headline: 10 dead in Cox's Bazar resort fire, 7 others injured
summary: The blaze at 'Tup-Tup Resort' in Inani beach area had no fire safety license, despite warnings from authorities in June.
details: At least 10 people have been killed and 7 others injured in a devastating fire at the 'Tup-Tup Resort' near Inani beach in Cox's Bazar.

The fire broke out on Saturday morning around 7:25 AM in the Patuartaek area of Ukhiya upazila. Firefighters from the Ukhiya fire station arrived at the scene after about 30 minutes, as the site was 18 kilometers away.
Two units of the Fire Service and Civil Defence reached the scene by 8:00 AM and brought the fire under control within 50 minutes. The blaze was fully extinguished by 11:00 AM.
Rescue operations led to the recovery of 10 bodies from inside the resort. The injured victims are currently receiving treatment at Cox's Bazar Sadar Hospital.

headline_marked: Doctor [[suspended after PM catches him smoking]] in hospital room
headline: Doctor suspended after PM catches him smoking in hospital room
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman ordered immediate action against a doctor at Bangladesh Shishu Hospital during a surprise visit.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman ordered action against a doctor at Bangladesh Shishu Hospital and Institute in Agargaon after finding him smoking in his room during a surprise visit.
Following the prime minister's directive, Associate Professor Rafiqul Islam was suspended from his position.
The prime minister expressed strong displeasure after finding the doctor smoking in a room that was also in an unhygienic condition.
During the visit, the prime minister inspected various departments of the hospital, assessing the working environment for health workers and the overall cleanliness of the facility.
Tarique Rahman instructed the chairman of the hospital's management board, Professor Dr AKM Azizul Haque, to take immediate action against the offending doctor.
The prime minister also emphasized the need for staff members to be more responsible in their duties and the necessity of maintaining a hygienic environment.
The visit was part of a series of surprise inspections of hospitals and educational institutions in the capital to assess the dengue situation and cleanliness activities.
caption:
A doctor was suspended on the spot after the Prime Minister caught him smoking in his room at a children's hospital.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman ordered action against a doctor at Bangladesh Shishu Hospital and Institute in Agargaon after finding him smoking in his room during a surprise visit.

Following the prime minister's directive, Associate Professor Rafiqul Islam was suspended from his position.

The prime minister expressed strong displeasure after finding the doctor smoking in a room that was also in an unhygienic condition.

During the visit, the prime minister inspected various departments of the hospital, assessing the working environment for health workers and the overall cleanliness of the facility.

Tarique Rahman instructed the chairman of the hospital's management board, Professor Dr AKM Azizul Haque, to take immediate action against the offending doctor.

The prime minister also emphasized the need for staff members to be more responsible in their duties and the necessity of maintaining a hygienic environment.

The visit was part of a series of surprise inspections of hospitals and educational institutions in the capital to assess the dengue situation and cleanliness activities.
